title: Timber Grid
tagline: Fit wooden pieces. Clear rows, columns, and 3×3 regions.
rulesSummary: Place all offered pieces; full rows, columns and 3×3 regions clear. The round ends when nothing fits.
helpPlace: Drag a piece from the tray onto the board, or select it with the keyboard and move the target with arrow keys. Enter/Space places it.
helpClear: A completely filled row, column, or 3×3 region clears and scores points.
helpCombo: Clearing on consecutive placements builds a combo bonus.
helpKeys: Keys: {nav} move target, {pieces} select piece, {place} place, {undo} undo, {hint} hint, {pause} pause, {camera} camera reset.
invalidBlocked: That cell is blocked or out of bounds.
noWebGL: 3D is unavailable; the accessible board below is fully playable.
masteryStage: Mastery stage — reach the goal to prove your skill.
progressMerged: Progress from another device was merged.
tutPlaceText: Drag a piece from the tray onto the board, or select it and choose a highlighted cell. Place any piece to continue.
tutClearText: Fill every cell of a row to clear it. Complete a row, column, or 3×3 region to continue.
tutComboText: Clear lines on consecutive placements to build a combo bonus. Make any placement to finish learning.
chLongGameDesc: Survive to 800 points with no move limit.
chComboForgeDesc: Reach 300 points in 14 placements — combos are the key.
prHardDesc: Bigger pieces appear more often. Unranked.
